name: Tatsumi
source:
He was injured and was taken care of at the dojo, then he became a free-loader there after he recovered.
His background is completely unknown but he has a certain skill with the sword and is quite arrogant and crude.
He's tasked by Iori to guard important people but he's forbidden from drawing his sword.
translation:
He was injured and was taken care of at the dojo, then he became a free-loader there after he recovered.
His background is completely unknown but he has a certain skill with the sword and is quite arrogant and crude.
He's tasked by Iori to guard important people but he's forbidden from drawing his sword.
